name: publicWeb_markChatRead
description: A web member opened a run or kennel chat (E9.F7.S15): resolves the public id and EXECs the app's own hcapp_markEventChatRead (@kind 'run') or hcapp_markKennelChatRead (@kind 'kennel'), so read state is one rule for both clients. Rooms are marked read by hcapp_getRoomMessages and DMs by hcapp_getDirectMessages, so 'room' and 'dm' are refused here. The token must be signed for the inner SP the kind selects; auth lives there. Reachable only through PublicWebAdminApi behind HC_INTERNAL_SECRET. Since 2026-10-03 every parameter has a default and @roomType / @threadId are accepted but unused, because the web's shared chatIds() sends every kind's id and a JSON null used to fail the call with 'too many arguments'. The bad-request refusal (1230) is logged to HC.ErrorLog since 2026-10-13.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: The calling browser's HC.Device id (the browser is a registered device).

rowsets.name: NotFoundEnvelope
rowsets.description: Wrapper refusal: @kind is not 'run'/'kennel', or the run/kennel is unknown, deleted or removed → { success 0, errorCode 1230, errorType 12 } ALONE — no detail rowset and no HC.ErrorLog row. Also the CATCH envelope (1500/5).

rowsets.name: AuthOrValidationError
rowsets.description: [kind 'run'] From hcapp_markEventChatRead: Returned when HC6.ValidateAppAuth fails or @eventId is NULL. errorType from ValidateAppAuth on auth failure. errorType=12, errorCode=1270 for null eventId. Mutually exclusive with the success rowsets.

rowsets.name: UnhandledError
rowsets.description: [kind 'run'] From hcapp_markEventChatRead: Returned from the CATCH block when an unexpected DB error occurs. errorCode=9999, errorType=5. Mutually exclusive with success rowsets and other error rowsets.

rowsets.name: LastSequenceCount
rowsets.description: [kind 'run'] From hcapp_markEventChatRead: Returned on success. The message count written to HC.EventMessageBadgeCounts.LastSequenceCount. Mutually exclusive with error rowsets.

columns.name: LastSequenceCount
columns.description: Total count of non-removed messages in HC.EventMessage for this event at the time the SP ran. Written to EventMessageBadgeCounts.LastSequenceCount.

rowsets.name: FcmFanoutTokens
rowsets.description: [kind 'run'] From hcapp_markEventChatRead: Returned on success at rowset 1. FCM tokens for the authenticated user's other registered devices. The API shim sends a silent 'read_sync' push to each to zero their badge count. May be empty (zero rows) if the user has only one device or no other devices have an FcmToken.

columns.name: FcmToken
columns.description: Device.FcmToken — Firebase Cloud Messaging token for a device owned by the same user, excluding the calling device. Table column is NVARCHAR(500) NULL, but the WHERE clause filters to IS NOT NULL.

columns.name: BadgeTotal
columns.description: The recipient's unread chat total for the app icon (HC6.UserUnreadChatTotal); the API puts it in aps.badge / notification_count / data.BadgeTotal. Added 2026-09-28. NULL for a device below HC6.MinBuildForIconBadge() (older apps never lower the icon).

rowsets.description: [kind 'kennel'] From hcapp_markKennelChatRead: On auth failure (ValidateAppAuth) or NULL kennelId (1901/2): the error detail alone, no envelope.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: [kind 'kennel'] From hcapp_markKennelChatRead: After the TRY block: success=1 when the MERGE committed; success=0 from the CATCH block (logged to HC.ErrorLog, but no errorId or detail is returned).

sideEffects: EXEC HC6.hcapp_markEventChatRead (kind 'run') — upserts HC.EventMessageBadgeCounts (EventId, UserId); logs its own refusals.
EXEC HC6.hcapp_markKennelChatRead (kind 'kennel') — MERGE HC.EventMessageBadgeCounts (KennelId, UserId); logs its own refusals.
hcapp_markEventChatRead's FcmFanoutTokens rowset (the reader's other devices) reaches the API, which does not send the read_sync push for this web action.

On an error that escapes the inner SP the CATCH rolls back, logs 'Unhandled error in publicWeb_markChatRead' to HC.ErrorLog (HcVersion '<web>', deviceId) and returns the envelope { success 0, errorCode 1500, errorType 5 } alone (no detail rowset).

codeSmells.detail: @roomType and @threadId (lines 25-26) are accepted and never read — deliberately, so the web's shared id set does not fail the call. Documented in the header (lines 11-18).

codeSmells.issue: NULL @kind slips past the kind check
codeSmells.detail: @kind NOT IN ('run','kennel') is UNKNOWN for NULL (line 36), so a NULL kind is not refused here and falls to the ELSE branch (line 45): hcapp_markKennelChatRead with @kennelId NULL, which refuses it (1901). Harmless, but the refusal comes from the wrong SP.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
